## Description and Rationale

y name is Mehmet Taşçı, a data professional dedicated to statistical learning, feature engineering, and high-performance predictive systems. My work focuses on translating chaotic, large-scale event data into clean, robust decision-support models—with a particular focus on operational research and time-sensitive optimization. 
I decided to participate in the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to tackle one of the most dynamic bottlenecks in modern aviation operations: taxi-out time variability. Airport surface operations are governed by interconnected, systemic factors—runway sequencing, gate congestion, and network ripple effects—making it an exceptional playground for data-driven modeling.

This challenge stands out because it demands more than just standard regression; it requires thoughtful feature architecture, handling multi-source constraints, and building solutions that hold up in live, practical environments. I look forward to testing my modeling hypotheses against peers worldwide and contributing actionable insights to the open-science aviation ecosystem.
